job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.workplace: Flexible – in person 1–2 times a month (Palo Alto / San Francisco)

details.about: MongoDB's data platform, including its multi-cloud MongoDB Atlas service on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure, is used by over 67,000 customers. This Senior Network Engineer takes ownership of key parts of MongoDB's global network: designing, deploying and troubleshooting network and VPN solutions, including Palo Alto Prisma Access, partnering with InfoSec on network security, and mentoring engineers.
duties: Own the design, deployment and operation of MongoDB's global Cisco Meraki network: routers, switches, firewalls, access points and IoT sensors
Lead the rollout and management of Palo Alto Prisma Access as MongoDB's SASE, with InfoSec
Run and evolve the network authentication stack, including RADIUS (EAP-TLS, PAP, RadSec, MAC authentication)
Improve network security controls with InfoSec: VLANs, firewall rules, DNS, DHCP and IDS/IPS
Design and deploy networks for new and existing global offices with Real Estate, Workplace, AV and Physical Security
Be the senior (L3) escalation point for complex network issues
Build automation to reduce manual network work and improve reliability and observability
Advise on relationships with ISPs, hardware, low-voltage cabling and other network vendors
Mentor engineers and communicate network strategy, risk and incidents to technical and non-technical stakeholders
needs: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
6+ years in network or systems engineering, with strong networking fundamentals (OSI model, routing, switching, IP subnetting, cabling, wireless)
Designing, deploying and troubleshooting high-availability network infrastructure at global scale
Hands-on experience with network platforms such as Cisco Meraki and HPE Aruba
VPN and secure access solutions such as Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cloudflare IPsec/L2TP and Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
Network authentication technologies such as FoxPass, LDAP and Okta (SAML)
Enterprise and cloud network design (high availability, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, subnetting, firewall rules)
Scripting for network automation using infrastructure as code
Network documentation such as rack elevations, patching matrices and layer 2/layer 3 topologies
Excellent communication and experience partnering with InfoSec, Physical Security and Workplace teams
Occasional work across time zones and travel
nice: CCNA, CCNP, Meraki Solutions Specialist or an equivalent certification
Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure) and hybrid network architectures
MDM and endpoint tools such as JAMF and Workspace ONE (AirWatch)
Working directly with ISPs and vendors on complex connectivity issues
details.benefits: Base salary $126,000 – $248,000 a year in the US; offers depend on skills, experience, qualifications and work location. Other benefits for eligible US employees may include equity, the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks of fully paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, a 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, transgender-inclusive health insurance and other health benefits.
notes: Based in Palo Alto / San Francisco, CA: candidates should live within commuting distance of both offices
Flexible arrangement, with in-person collaboration typically 1–2 times a month
Involves travel and occasional work across time zones for global office builds
